task: wiki #14 — weather particles: rain particle layer tied to WeatherController

particle_texture.reason: Unity built-in Default-Particle sprite is sufficient for rain streaks; no external PNG needed. Stretch renderMode + size3D aspect ratio produces thin downward-falling streaks without a custom texture.

rain_particle_spec.pattern: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] self-attaching, DontDestroyOnLoad, HideAndDontSave — identical to RainSoundDriver.cs and FlickerLight.cs
rain_particle_spec.sorting_rationale: above NightOverlay(25) and ground(0-7)/pawn(9-11), below PawnFloatingBars(29-31) and UI Canvas(200+)
rain_particle_spec.color_tint: rgba(0.565, 0.647, 0.706, 0.40) — cool blue-grey, WATER_* family, low alpha so pawns remain legible
rain_particle_spec.shader: Particles/Standard Unlit with alpha-blend (SrcAlpha / OneMinusSrcAlpha); fallback Sprites/Default
rain_particle_spec.camera_follow: Update() repositions PS transform to camera.position + (0, SpawnAboveCam=5.5, -1) each frame
rain_particle_spec.clear_weather: emission rate=0, PS.Clear(), PS.Stop — in-flight particles cleared immediately on Clear transition

state_machine.guard: _lastKind + _initialized flag, mirrors RainSoundDriver._lastKind pattern — no per-frame restart

binary_acceptance: wiki #14 — During a storm a rain particle layer is visible; clear weather has none.

QA: Rain alpha (0.40 base, gradient 0-1-1-0 over lifetime) must NOT occlude pawn sprites or UI bars — verify pawn silhouettes remain legible through rain
QA: sortingOrder=26 places rain above NightOverlay(25); verify rain draws above the night dark overlay during night storms
QA: No particle texture PNG was generated; driver uses Unity built-in Default-Particle — verify ParticleSystemRenderer material resolves without import error
QA: WeatherController.cs was NOT edited — verify WeatherController.Instance.Current reads correctly from a separate file (same property RainSoundDriver polls)
QA: Camera-follow logic runs in Update() — verify no jitter or 1-frame lag at camera edges during panning
QA: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod] guard (FindFirstObjectByType) — verify no duplicate ~WeatherParticleDriver GameObjects on scene reload
constraints_respected: No prefab or scene edit — ParticleSystem built 100% in code
No particle PNG generated — Unity built-in sprite used
